name: Su Kutlu
bio:
Su Kutlu was born in 1991 in Istanbul, Turkey. She is an actress, known for Birlikte Ölecegiz, Aile Arasinda (2017) and Söz (2017).

Her grandfather's mother is Jew and redhead. In some sources, ashkenazi jews are of Turkic descent. Firstly, Turkics lived in Khakassia and have red hair and blue eyes. Her paternal family is Rum.

She is a Turkish citizen. Firstly, Turkics lived in Khakassia and have red hair and blue eyes. They immigrated to East Asia, Europe, India, Africa. In some sources, Ashkenazi were of Turkic descent.

credits.title: Together, We Shall Die
credits.overview: After completing his specialty in Canada, Mazhar returned to Istanbul. As he mourns his mother, he falls in love with Ece, who is also the lover of Erman, Mazhar’s best friend. Mazhar and Ece will live a passionate and devastating love in the midst of the vicissitudes of the city.

credits.title: In the Family
credits.overview: When their long-term relationships collapse on the same day, a neurotic man and an eccentric lounge singer cross paths. To help her daughter marry into a conservative, wealthy family, he reluctantly agrees to pose as her dignified police chief father.
